source_review.scope: All acceptance driver modules, focused failure tests, six reviewed source commits, and acceptance guide.
findings: The final driver includes every reviewed source change.
Transport recording, native references, submitted jobs, image state, and workflow coordination have separate owners.
Shared numerical helpers avoid duplicate conversion rules while preserving exact immutable and recovered records.
Tests cover meaningful evidence failures, recorded rounding, and continued public cleanup.
The fixed acceptance driver uses no hidden domain setup or emergency fallback.

payload_review.method: Compare parsed records and supported OPM reader results with the manifest sources.
payload_review.scope: Public trial records, source snapshots, numerical output bundles, identity, recovery, cleanup, and explicit failed-trial status.

findings: The delivery status agrees with completed trial 04 and merged prerequisites.
Duplicate service and evidence entries are removed from the development index.
Wider P16 recovery acceptance and P17 release acceptance remain separate.
The recorded custom native build remains a required runtime limit.
